text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Iraq's oil to flow to international markets in next few days.
- Turkish foreign minister says Iraq's pipeline via Turkey is ready.
- UAE is determined to liberate its three Islands occupied by Iran.
- U.N. oil overseers arrive in Iraq today.
- Iraq starts oil talks with Russian firms.
- Jordan and Iraq sign trade deal.
- Oil minister says Iraqi to sign oil contracts with more than 50 firms in next two days.
- Iraqi-Jordanian land transport company completes preparation for ferrying food and medical stuffs to Iraq.
- UAE President asks for lifting of sanctions on Iraq despite U.S. pressure.
- High-ranking Jordanian delegation to visit Iraq.
